summary.text: PRESTEGÅRDSBAKKEN BORETTSLAG is a housing cooperative registered in Stavanger, founded 1968-01-09. Prestegårdsbakken Borettslag is a housing cooperative. It was previously named PARKEN BORETTSLAG until 2026-04-16. Its main industry code is 97.001: activities of housing cooperatives. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 4 335 717 NOK and the annual result was 397 579 NOK; operating income was up from 4 029 367 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 10 758 NOK in 2024 to 397 579 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from -3 144 765 NOK in 2024 to -2 747 186 NOK in 2025. Recent changes in the register: business address set to Laberget 22 on 2026-07-27; name set to PRESTEGÅRDSBAKKEN BORETTSLAG on 2026-04-17.
